svg.aria-label: A cozy night-time room where Mishkat's neon robot cat sleeps in its charging basket, wakes up, chases a laser dot across the rug and goes back to bed. On the walls: a neon sign for mishkat2025.github.io, a B.Sc. in CSE from East West University (class of 2027), sticky notes for the student management system, the RAG assistant and CS² for Everyone, and a map pinned on Dhaka. The bookshelf spines list the skills.
